text: This is not a standalone converter. Accuphase's own page describes the DAC-50 as an OPTION BOARD that installs in a rear slot of a supported component, so the device a listener actually owns is the host amplifier or player, and that is what the driver will name. The record is kept because its chip-level facts hold, but it cannot be matched by a model name a listener would recognise, and its inputs belong to the host. The inverse of the RME and Schiit case: there a model name covered several devices, here a model name is a part of one.
